column1: # Every browser cache of a server answer in the production client (tests/frontend/helpers/browser-caches.mjs finds them:
# a value kept across calls, or browser storage, written in a function that awaits a server read) and how it follows the
# signed-in person's access. Columns: file (under js/), name, class, reason. Classes: uncached = only a read in flight is shared;
# revisioned = dropped when the server's access revision moves (the 'je-access-revision' event the tag pipeline raises
# from the filter revision every tag answer carries) and on a user switch; revalidated = the server is asked every time and
# the kept copy only answers an unchanged reply; shared = the same for everyone; own = the person's own JE data or settings,
# which they change themselves; item = Jellyfin's own answer about an item, drawn only on that item's own page or player,
# which Jellyfin authorizes on every visit; account = the person's Seerr account link or the page bootstrap, which the
# server checks again on every read and request; state = not an answer (timers, controllers, positions, UI state).
# The core response cache (js/core/api-client.js) keeps only the prefixes in its SHARED_CACHE_PREFIXES.
